Fastener SuperStore offers a simple to use online catalog of more than 45,000 screws, bolts, rivets,
spacers, standoffs and other fasteners. We sell bulk quantities at great prices. Our parts are
shipped from multiple locations across the US and shipped as quickly as possible, usually on the
same day the order is placed.

Our wide product selection includes 17 types of screws, all available in a variety of styles,
materials, finishes & sizes. Stainless steel options are offered in most screw categories, including
machine, self-drilling, self tapping / sheet metal, thread cutting and thread forming screws.

Bolts, nuts, washers, rivets and sockets round out our most popular categories, while our extensive
collection of spacers, standoffs and rack mounting cage nuts are commonly purchased for use in small
electronics.

Our products are sold in bulk quantities, generally for industrial use. If you need larger
quantities than what's displayed on our site, we can often quote much better pricing than our
already discounted multi-carton prices. Sockets are a fastener line which we can often offer at
particularly deep discounts.
